summary.text: Pat Proctor is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. A retired U.S. Army colonel and restaurant owner, he has represented Kansas House District 41 since 2021 and chairs the House Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2019, rising from private to colonel, with combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan.
Owns restaurants in Leavenworth and Manhattan with his wife and has taught in the Homeland Security program at Wichita State University.
Kansas House of Representatives, District 41, since 2021; chairs the House Elections Committee and the Joint Committee on Kansas Security.
